name: brand-identity
body: kalide's own visual identity: the user-supplied faceted-hexagon mark with an orange facet, as dark and light tiles (`brand/logo_dark.svg`, `brand/logo_light.svg`); the name "kalide" as lowercase Helvetica text; palette `#0F1115` / `#F8F9FA` / `#FF5722`. Repository/documentation collateral only — distinct from any deck template/theme branding, and repository-only (global.constraint.core-unbranded, requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded).
